description: Buy a domain for the app — not available yet. Buying a domain through Uarpie is not switched on, so every call is refused and nothing is bought. Do not offer it. If the person already owns a domain, attach it with add_domain. If they need one, they can buy it from any domain seller and then attach it with add_domain.

confirm.description: true only after the person heard the confirmation sentence and said yes.

contact.description: The registrant's real details, required by the registry. Second call only.

domain.description: The name wanted, with or without an ending.

order_id.description: Read an existing order's progress instead of buying: pass the id returned by the second call.

privacy.description: Hide the registrant's details from public WHOIS. Defaults to true.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.

quote_id.description: From the first call. Present only on the second call, after the person agreed.

name: buy_domain
title: Buy a domain (not available yet)
